definitions.explanation: All members of a group; everyone present. Often used in formal contexts like letters and speeches.

examples.japanese: {社員|しゃいん}{一同|いちどう}より。
{一同|いちどう}、{心|こころ}よりお{祝|いわ}い{申|もう}し{上|あ}げます。
examples.english: We all offer our heartfelt congratulations.

examples.japanese: {スタッフ|すたっふ}{一同|いちどう}、お{待|ま}ちしております。
examples.english: All the staff look forward to seeing you.

notes:
{一同|いちどう} is used to refer to all members of a group, especially in formal contexts.

COMMON USAGES:
- {社員|しゃいん}{一同|いちどう}: all employees
- {家族|かぞく}{一同|いちどう}: the whole family
- スタッフ{一同|いちどう}: all the staff
- {関係者|かんけいしゃ}{一同|いちどう}: all parties involved

TYPICAL CONTEXTS:
- Formal letters and cards
- Speeches and greetings
- Gift tags and messages
- Condolence messages

FORMAL EXPRESSIONS:
- {一同|いちどう}より: from everyone
- {一同|いちどう}、{心|こころ}より〜: we all, from the heart...
